How a round runs

Open, call, close. Nothing in between.

01

Choose a coin.

Any pair with real depth on Solana can host a round. Shallow books are left out.

02

Make the call.

The strike is the last traded price. You back YES or NO before the lock and the pool shows where everyone stands.

Watch it close.

Principles

Built so nobody has to be trusted.

These are the design rules the rounds are written against. They describe intent, and they bind every release.

01

Self-custody.

Stakes are held in an escrow owned by the round's program and leave only as winnings or handed-back stakes.

02

No referee.

The closing price comes from a public feed. No operator key can overrule a closed round.

03

Refund on doubt.

If the price source is stale or unsure, the round is voided and all stakes are handed back.
